title: Build a Bootstrap Product Catalog with Search and Filter
description: Create a responsive product catalog using Bootstrap cards with JavaScript search and category filter
objective: Students will build a product catalog page using Bootstrap components, implement real-time search filtering, category filtering using JavaScript array methods, and persist user preferences with localStorage

steps.title: Set Up the Bootstrap Project
steps.instructions:

steps.title: Create the Product Data
steps.instructions:
In `app.js`, create a product array:

```javascript

    { id: 3, name: "Lenovo IdeaPad", price: 38000, category: "laptop", image: "💻", desc: "AMD Ryzen 5, 8GB RAM, 256GB SSD" },
    { id: 4, name: "Redmi Note 13", price: 15000, category: "phone", image: "📱", desc: "6GB RAM, 128GB, AMOLED Display" },
    { id: 5, name: "Samsung Galaxy M34", price: 18000, category: "phone", image: "📱", desc: "8GB RAM, 128GB, 6000mAh" },

    { id: 9, name: "USB Hub 4-Port", price: 1200, category: "accessory", image: "🔌", desc: "USB 3.0, Aluminium Body" },
```

This array will be our data source — we never modify it, only filter it.

steps.title: Render Products Dynamically
Add Search and Filter
Test Everything
steps.instructions:
Test these scenarios:

| Action | Expected |
|--------|----------|
| Page loads | All 10 products visible |
| Type "keyboard" | Only Mechanical Keyboard shows |
| Select "Laptops" | 3 laptop cards |
| Select "Laptops" + search "hp" | Only HP Laptop |
| Select "All" + clear search | All 10 products |
| Search "xyz" | "No products found" message |
| Click "Add to Cart" | Cart count increases |
| Refresh page | Cart count persists (localStorage) |
| Resize to mobile | Cards stack in single column |

Open Console (F12):
- There should be no errors
- Type `products.length` — should return 10
- Type `localStorage.getItem('cartCount')` — should show your cart count

**Submit:** Your `index.html` and `app.js` files.

expected_output: A responsive product catalog with real-time search, category filtering, cart counter, and localStorage persistence — built with Bootstrap cards and JavaScript array methods
